spec.rawSql:
WITH target_instrument AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM instruments
  WHERE id IN ($instrument)
)

SELECT
  o.start_time AS time,
  o.end_time AS timeEnd,
  t.name || ' OFF' AS title,
  'SEM server offline' AS text
FROM em_off o
JOIN target_instrument t
  ON o.instrument_id = t.id

SELECT
  hour AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "1-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_hourly
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'E-Column.IGP1'
  AND $__timeFilter(hour)
ORDER BY hour

SELECT
  day AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "24-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_daily
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'E-Column.IGP1'
  AND $__timeFilter(day)
ORDER BY day

SELECT
  hour AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "1-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_hourly
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name IN ('IGP3Parameter', 'I-Column.IGP3')
  AND $__timeFilter(hour)
ORDER BY hour

SELECT
  day AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "24-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_daily
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name IN ('IGP3Parameter', 'I-Column.IGP3')
  AND $__timeFilter(day)
ORDER BY day

WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id, param_name
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name IN ('I-Column.IGP1_PeakCount', 'I-Column.IGP2_PeakCount')
    AND subsystem = 'Vacuum'
)
SELECT
  p.param_name,
  MAX(d.value_num) - MIN(d.value_num) AS counts
FROM data d
JOIN state_param p USING (param_id)
WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
GROUP BY p.param_name

WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id, param_name
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name IN ('I-Column.IGP3_PeakCount', 'I-Column.IGP4_PeakCount')
    AND subsystem = 'Vacuum'
)
SELECT
  p.param_name,
  MAX(d.value_num) - MIN(d.value_num) AS counts
FROM data d
JOIN state_param p USING (param_id)
WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
GROUP BY p.param_name

WITH counter_param AS (
  SELECT instrument_id, param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FIB'
    AND param_name IN ('SourceAgeParameter', 'OperatingTimeFIBParameter')
),

filtered AS (
  SELECT
    d.time,
    d.value_num AS operate_time
  FROM data d
  JOIN counter_param p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
),

changes AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    operate_time,
    lag(operate_time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_value
  FROM filtered
),

last_replacement AS (
  SELECT time
  FROM changes
  WHERE operate_time < prev_value   -- counter reset
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

last_value AS (
  SELECT last(operate_time, time) AS source_age
  FROM filtered
)

SELECT
  lv.source_age / 3600 AS "Source age",
  lr.time AS "Last replacement"
FROM last_value lv
LEFT JOIN last_replacement lr ON true

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FIB'
    AND param_name = 'EmissionFIBParameter'
)

SELECT
  time,
  value
FROM unnest((
  SELECT lttb(
    time,
    value_num,
    2 * (($__to - $__from) / $__interval_ms)::int
  )
  FROM data
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_id = (SELECT param_id FROM matching_param)
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
))
ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: LMIS heat cycles / PFIB ignition count

spec.rawSql:
SELECT d.value_num
FROM data d
JOIN parameters p
  ON d.param_id = p.param_id
WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND p.component = 'FIB'
  AND p.param_name IN ('TotalLifetimeHeatsParameter', 'TotalIgnitionCountParameter')
ORDER BY d.time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH latest_week AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 week', max(d.time)) AS bucket
  FROM data d
  JOIN parameters p
    ON d.instrument_id = p.instrument_id
   AND d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND p.component = 'FIB'
    AND p.param_name IN ('SuccessfulIgnitionCountParameter', 'TotalIgnitionCountParameter')
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(delta(counter_agg(d.time, d.value_num) FILTER (WHERE p.param_name = 'SuccessfulIgnitionCountParameter')), 0), 1)::float
  /
  COALESCE(NULLIF(delta(counter_agg(d.time, d.value_num) FILTER (WHERE p.param_name = 'TotalIgnitionCountParameter')), 0), 1) AS ratio

FROM data d
JOIN parameters p
  ON d.instrument_id = p.instrument_id
 AND d.param_id = p.param_id
JOIN latest_week lw
  ON time_bucket('1 week', d.time) = lw.bucket
WHERE p.instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND p.component = 'FIB'
  AND p.param_name IN ('SuccessfulIgnitionCountParameter', 'TotalIgnitionCountParameter')

SELECT
  average(stats_agg(d.value_num)) AS avg_flow
FROM
  data d
  JOIN parameters p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
WHERE
  d.instrument_id = $instrument 
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND p.component = 'FIB'
  AND p.param_name = 'JacketFlowParameter'

WITH params AS (
  SELECT instrument_id, param_id, param_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FIB'
    AND param_name LIKE 'GasUsage_%Parameter'
),

totals AS (
  SELECT
    substring(p.param_name FROM '^GasUsage_(.+)Parameter$') AS gas_type,
    delta(counter_agg(d.time, d.value_num)) AS total_usage
  FROM data d
  JOIN params p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d.time)
  GROUP BY p.param_name
)

SELECT
  gas_type,
  total_usage,
  total_usage * 100.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(total_usage) OVER (), 0) AS pct_of_total
FROM totals
ORDER BY pct_of_total DESC

SELECT
  hour AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "1-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_hourly
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'E-Column.IGP2'
  AND $__timeFilter(hour)
ORDER BY hour

SELECT
  day AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "24-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_daily
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'E-Column.IGP2'
  AND $__timeFilter(day)
ORDER BY day

SELECT
  hour AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "1-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_hourly
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'IGP4Parameter'
  AND $__timeFilter(hour)
ORDER BY hour

SELECT
  day AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "24-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_daily
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'IGP4Parameter'
  AND $__timeFilter(day)
ORDER BY day

WITH cagg AS (
  SELECT
    p.enum_id,
    state_agg(d.time, d.value_num :: int) AS agg
  FROM
    data d
    JOIN parameters p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
  WHERE
    d.instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND p.param_name = 'ExternalStateParameter'
    AND p.component = 'FEG'
  GROUP BY
    p.enum_id
)
SELECT
  ev.member_name AS state,
  COUNT(*) AS interval_count
FROM
  cagg
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL state_int_timeline(agg) s
  JOIN enum_values ev ON ev.enum_id = cagg.enum_id AND ev.value = s.state
GROUP BY
  ev.member_name
ORDER BY
  ev.member_name

WITH counter_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FEG'
    AND param_name = 'OperateTimeFEGParameter'
)

SELECT d.value_num AS "OperationTimeCounter"
FROM data d
JOIN counter_param p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time) 
ORDER BY d.time DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'FEG'
    AND param_name = 'EmissionFEGParameter'
)

SELECT
  time,
  value
FROM unnest((
  SELECT lttb(
    time,
    value_num,
    2 * (($__to - $__from) / $__interval_ms)::int
  )
  FROM data
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_id = (SELECT param_id FROM matching_param)
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
))
ORDER BY 1;
